svg.title: Stock XDJ-RX3 1.19 crossfader gain curves
svg.desc: A chart comparing the MID, MID HALF, and SHARP single-deck lookup tables. Position zero is the audible edge and position one is the muted edge. MID falls smoothly, SHARP remains at unity until the last sample, and MID HALF reaches silence near the center.
svg.text: Firmware 1.19 · exact 1,024-entry lookup tables · single-deck, channel-relative response
